_comment: Committed pin manifest for the external artifacts this repo downloads: the SemIf engine ref, the pinned GGUF, the HF tokenizer revision, and the simplex-chat binary. These are code-owned, deployment-independent values bumped by a git change and picked up on the next `scripts/bootstrap.sh` run. They are deliberately NOT in config.json (per-machine user config): a ref that changes with every update is not user configuration. The agent reads engine.source/revision from here; the GGUF path is derived from engine.gguf_url unless config.json overrides engine.gguf.
